parole.testo: Borrowed from Mexican Spanish taco (“taco”). The origin of the Spanish food name is uncertain. It may be a transferred use of taco (“plug, wad”), perhaps because rolled tacos were compared with the paper-wrapped explosive charges known as tacos in Mexican mines.
